clues.text: Among the Benjamite soldiers at Gibeah, seven hundred left-handers could hit a hair with a stone using this.
After taking off Saul's armor, David picked five smooth stones from the brook and went out holding this.
David reached into his bag and used this to send a stone into the Philistine's forehead.
God warned Shebna, the palace steward, that He would roll him into a ball and hurl him into a wide land this way.
Abigail told David that God would fling away his enemies' lives like stones from this.
Benjamite warriors who joined David at Ziklag could use this with either hand, as well as shoot arrows.
A proverb says giving honor to a fool is like binding a stone into this.
